title: Highlights Tour at the Museum of Fine Arts Houston
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the highlights of Houston’s Museum of Fine Arts without feeling overwhelmed by its massive collection. 

This guided tour is designed for visitors who want to make the most of their museum experience by seeing the most notable artworks, learning memorable stories behind them, and finding the best photo-worthy spots along the way.

Instead of wandering through hundreds of galleries unsure of what to focus on, guests will be guided through a curated selection of the museum’s must-see pieces across different styles and time periods. 

Perfect for first-time museum visitors and travelers short on time. You'll see art and learn history that you can share with friends back home.

Highlights:
• Notable artworks in the Picasso, Matisse, and Klee exhibition
• Feel like a kid again in Ernesto Neto's elevated ocean ball pit
• Photo opportunities in the various colorful light installations 
• Notable pieces from around the world including Africa, Asia, the Americas, & Europe
